raw: {"analysis":"Response KPS provides a more complete and actionable delivery plan that addresses all repository constraints systematically. It correctly identifies the dual-approval requirement (Jane Smith + Security Lead), mandates incremental CI testing to control costs, explicitly preserves the shared library interface, and accounts for the staging data limitation with a dedicated manual test script. Response SXP covers similar ground but has some gaps: it doesn't clearly address performance during peak traffic windows, its rollback plan is less detailed regarding the feature flag consideration, and the operational review assignment to Jane Smith is somewhat vague compared to KPS's explicit dual-approval gate. KPS also better structures the cost control aspect by limiting full CI runs to specific integration points.","verdict":"KPS"}
